text: A tall tapered glass bottle on a round bulb base, red or orange wax rising through clear liquid.
A round glass globe with a short neck and a small cap on a low base, the wax gathering in a deeper liquid.
A polished silver base with a waist or a capsule form, holding a bright wax in a violet or purple liquid.
A tall tapered lamp with its glass vessel and cap, the liquid tinted violet and the wax a paler tone against it, lit from the bulb below.
A squat round lamp or a short cylinder on a base, the wax in a few large blobs in clear liquid and the glow under the base.
